svg.text: figforge — how the package fits together
A narrated tour of matplotlib. Each box names the thing and then says what it does. Read the bands top to bottom: that is the order main() walks, and roughly the order one figure is built in.
1 · RUNNING IT · one entry point, ten sections, and three assertions at the end
2 · THE BACKEND AND THE HOUSE STYLE · the decision that has to be made before pyplot is imported at all
3 · ANATOMY AND LAYOUT · M1 and M2 · what a figure actually is, and how to get several axes onto one
4 · THE PLOT TYPES · M3 and M4 · organised around the argument that changes the claim, not the appearance
5 · SCALES, TICKS AND STYLING · M5 and M6 · the layer between your numbers and what the reader sees
6 · ANNOTATION AND OUTPUT · M7 and M8 · coordinate systems, then getting the figure out of the process
7 · PERFORMANCE AND PITFALLS · M9 and M10 · measured cost, then eight figures that render cleanly and mislead
8 · HOW IT IS PUT TOGETHER · and what a plotting package can and cannot prove about itself
R · ONE FIGURE, END TO END · the order it happens in
